lines.zh: 我只在夜里出来，一个人。
lines.en: I only come out at night, alone.

lines.zh: 我的身体很薄，从侧面看像没有。
lines.en: My body is thin. From the side I look like nothing.
I walk between the shadows.
A branch scrapes me and I move aside.
Leaves bend under me and spring back.

lines.zh: 我沿着黑暗走，避开月光。
lines.en: I keep to the dark, away from moonlight.
The moonlight never reaches my side.
You can't hear me breathe.
I move toward whatever light is left.

lines.zh: 那是最容易捕到的地方。
lines.en: That's where catching is easiest.
Step by step, very lightly.
I never bring company.
I stand against a trunk.
My eyes are two pieces of void.

lines.zh: 我的护甲，是我自己长出来的。
lines.en: My armor grew out of me.
Thin, and hard.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里所有的声音。
lines.en: I'm listening to every sound in the wood.
A bird is asleep.
A leaf is falling.
There's a person, holding their breath.
You can't hold it very long.
Only my outline sits in the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 夜里我只来一只，三十五点血。
lines.en: At night I come alone, with thirty-five health.
You held it. Too late.
I came alone.
I always come alone.
That's my rule.
You have firelight on you.
That won't keep me off.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，里面什么都没有。
lines.en: My eyes have nothing inside them.
Look into them and you'll get colder.
Whatever you do, don't look at my eyes.
My body dimmed.

lines.zh: 我有一个洞，虚空从里面漏。
lines.en: There's a hole in me, and void leaks out.
I retreat into deeper shadow.
That made me much thinner.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓重新叠了起来。
lines.en: My outline folds itself back together.
Your feet haven't moved.

lines.zh: 破口的边缘，慢慢长回来。
lines.en: The torn edges of me slowly knit back.
I'll always be here.
The tree shadows cover me.
The night in this wood is long.
You raise the fire.
Light makes you easier to see.
I turn my face aside a little.

lines.zh: 把光收起来，我讨厌发亮的东西。
lines.en: Put the light away, I hate glowing things.
But I'll wait for it to die down.
Torches always burn out.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，快烧完了。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is nearly out.
Hold it up a while longer.
I'll give the torch a little time.
I'll just wait for it to die.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞到冷空气。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting cold air.

lines.zh: 我的手已经在你背上了。
lines.en: My hand is already on your back.

lines.zh: 这一下，你背上多了道口。
lines.en: Now there's a cut across your back.
The cut isn't deep.
At night, I never travel in pairs.
I'm watching how you react.

lines.zh: 你转过身来，夜里的影子只有我一个。
lines.en: Turn around; only my shadow walks tonight.
Cold air settles on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我的护甲蹭到你的手臂。
lines.en: My armor grazes your arm.
That spot will stay cold a long while.

lines.zh: 我只在夜里出来，身体薄得看不出。
lines.en: I only come out at night, so thin you miss me.

lines.zh: 有另一个我，在这片林子里。
lines.en: There's another of me in this wood.
We never meet.
Meeting means fighting.
So we each keep half.
The east is mine.
The west is its.
We don't cross the stream between.
That's quiet enough.
You'd better not go west.
This charm still holds someone's warmth.
An amulet, still warm.
I keep it.
Not because it's useful.
Because it belonged to someone.

lines.zh: 那些人的东西，我都留着。
lines.en: I keep what they leave behind.
In a heap in the wood.
No one knows where.
You won't get the chance either.
Walk over here yourself.
A small light over there.
That light isn't a torch.
It's two eyes.
My face turns toward those eyes.
It turns the lamp my way.

lines.zh: 它手里的火把晃了一下。
lines.en: The torch in its hand wavers.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干，薄成一道缝。
lines.en: I press against the trunk, thin as a seam.
I've made myself thin.

lines.zh: 它的视线从我身上滑过去。
lines.en: Its gaze slides right off me.

lines.zh: 它往林子深处走了两步。
lines.en: It takes two steps deeper into the woods.
At night only one of me comes.
Its neck is exposed.
This distance will do.
My hand comes out from behind the tree.
It heard something.
Its back is open, and I make no sound.
I follow behind, very quietly.
It's fast, but it's panting.
My legs don't need to be fast.

lines.zh: 我只要在它停的时候到。
lines.en: I only need to arrive when it stops.
It circles a tree.
I go around the other side.
We meet.
I walk alone at night, never in company.
It backs to the trunk and edges sideways.
There are stones there.
It hit a stone.
I step in.
It hauls itself up on a trunk.
And running slower.
I keep following.
The moon lights it.
The moonlight doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 它停下来的时候，我就到。
lines.en: When it stops, I arrive.
It's half a step from the black patch.
Its back is to me.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里伸出一只手。
lines.en: I reach a hand out of the shadow.
It catches nothing.
I catch its calf.

lines.zh: 虚空顺着我的手指上去。
lines.en: Void climbs from my fingers.
A sound squeezes out of its throat.
I claw again.
The shoulder this time.
It's backed against the trunk.
I press my whole body to it.
My armor is against it.
It pushes me. I don't move.
It starts to slide down.
I slowly let go.

lines.zh: 我的手从它肩上收回来。
lines.en: I draw my hand back from its shoulder.
I stand beside it and watch.
Then I leave.
Its breathing has slowed.
I crouch to its height.
I draw back off it.
The wood is dreadfully still.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I step out of a tree's shadow.
It's fully dark.
This is when I come out.

lines.zh: 我身上带着虚空的味道。
lines.en: I carry the smell of void.
There's no wind in the wood.
No wind. Just right.
First I walk a circuit.
Nothing else in the east.

lines.zh: 西边有一道很淡的气味。
lines.en: A very faint scent in the west.
That's the other one.
I don't plan to go there.
I change direction.
The firelight drives me far back.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下，落地没有声。
lines.en: I drop from the tree and land silently.

lines.zh: 水一浸，我的虚空被填满了。
lines.en: Water soaks in and fills my void.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀开，我散了一半。
lines.en: The blast throws me and half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，箭杆变黑了。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and the shaft turns black.
A light burns at my void.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，已经没有活的了。
lines.en: There's nothing living left in this wood.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，林子亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning falls and the wood is bright for an instant.

lines.zh: 这里我熟，我就在这儿生出来的。
lines.en: I know this place. It's where I was born.
